clue.text: Drug isn't affected when taking a temperature

indicators.note: taking means holding or admitting, so the shuffled letters close round the following pieces
affected in the sense of disturbed or altered, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A medical warning that some medicine stops working once you take someone's temperature.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'isn't' is ignored; 'affected' shuffles its four letters, which then split to hold 'a temperature'.
explanation.definitionFit: A statin is a cholesterol-lowering medication, so it is a kind of drug.

clue.text: Tidy tree

definitions.meaning: neat and smart in appearance, or to smarten up

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both neat and smart and a kind of conifer, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: In the morning Southern Republican rises with character

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means read from the bottom up

parts.note: and means with, joining things together

explanation.surface: A morning rise of a Southern Republican, with a show of character.
explanation.definitionFit: The symbol & is a typographic character, a printed sign.

clue.text: 9 is cooler

definitions.meaning: refers to the answer at 9 across, a hip-hop vocalist; the one meant is the West Coast star of N.W.A.
a frozen block dropped into a drink to chill it

explanation.definitionFit: It is the stage name of an American hip-hop artist and also a frozen cube that chills drinks.

clue.text: Investment by independent fellow in charge is precise

parts.note: a spec is a speculative investment, as in buying something on spec
F is the abbreviation for fellow, as in FRS
IC is the abbreviation for in charge, as in second-in-command

explanation.surface: A financial note that a self-employed person running things invested with exactness.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something exact and clearly defined rather than vague.

clue.text: Deciphering Poe's title originally reveals ghostly spirit

indicators.note: deciphering means working out a code, so the letters are rearranged
originally asks for the opening letter of each of the two words before it

explanation.surface: Decoding the title of an Edgar Allan Poe story uncovers a ghost.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy, mischievous ghost that throws things about is a kind of spirit.

clue.text: Seals off most of tank's mechanical device on ship

parts.note: caps seal the tops of bottles

indicators.note: most of means drop the final letter of the word

parts.note: a tank, the possessive just making the surface read

explanation.surface: Seals emerging from a tank aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotating drum on deck used to wind cables or anchor chains is a ship's machine.

clue.text: Loud noise before noon brings sign of disapproval

indicators.note: before puts the noise ahead of the letter for noon

parts.note: f, forte, is the musical marking for loud
a row is a din or racket

explanation.surface: A racket before midday earns a disapproving look.
explanation.definitionFit: Knitting the brows is a facial sign of displeasure.

clue.text: Will supplements treat colds around here in Brittany?

indicators.note: around means the shuffled letters go round the next piece
to treat is to process or work on, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: ici is French for here, and Brittany is in France

explanation.surface: A doctor in Brittany wondering about treating colds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Will' with its capital looks like a name or a verb, but here it is the legal document; the French word is wrapped by the shuffled colds.
explanation.definitionFit: Additions to a will that amend it are formal supplements to the document.

clue.text: One knocks musical performer

definitions.meaning: someone who taps or bangs on a door, or a door knocker
a hip-hop artist who delivers rhymed lyrics over a beat

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a person who knocks and a hip-hop vocalist, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Mistake way driving on this?

parts.note: a slip is a small error
a road is a way, as in a route

explanation.surface: A puzzled driver wondering whether the route they took was an error.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a definition by example: you drive on this when joining or leaving a motorway.
explanation.definitionFit: A short connecting carriageway onto or off a motorway is something you drive along, hence the cryptic hint.

clue.text: Body cells lining epiglottis initially that may be red or white

definitions.text: that may be red or white

parts.note: a corpus is a body, as in a body of writings, from the Latin for body

indicators.note: initially asks for the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: An anatomy lesson about the cells lining the epiglottis.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is descriptive: blood holds both red and white cells.
explanation.definitionFit: Blood cells come in two familiar kinds, red carrying oxygen and white fighting infection.

clue.text: Act out a Greek choral song? That would be a disaster!

indicators.note: out in the sense of wrong or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a strophe is a stanza sung by the chorus in Greek drama

explanation.surface: Someone warning that staging a Greek chorus would end badly.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden calamity or ruinous event is a disaster, a synonym.

clue.text: It's invigorating to be part of pageant on ice

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A spectator enthusing about how exhilarating it is to take part in a show on ice.
explanation.definitionFit: A pick-me-up drink or medicine is something that refreshes and invigorates.

clue.text: Australian state representatives slang teenager behaving badly

indicators.note: behaving badly suggests the letters are misbehaving, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unruly adolescent using slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Each Australian state once sent an official envoy to London; these officers carried that title.

clue.text: Seventies band heard Stones finally play with harmony

indicators.note: heard says the word for stones is taken as it sounds

parts.note: rocks are stones

indicators.note: finally asks for the last letter of the word that follows

parts.note: music is harmony, sweet sounds

explanation.surface: A seventies band heard the Rolling Stones play in harmony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stones' tempts you towards the Rolling Stones; it just means ROCKS, which 'heard' turns into ROX.
explanation.definitionFit: Bryan Ferry's art-rock group had its heyday in the 1970s.

clue.text: Sailor posted to Eastern Spain becomes missing person

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
sent means posted, as a letter
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A sailor posted to eastern Spain goes missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone not present where expected, at work or school, is a missing person.

clue.text: Having expanded submits at heart to measurement of obesity

definitions.text: Having expanded submits at heart to measurement of obesity

parts.words: Having expanded submits at heart to measurement of obesity
parts.note: the central three letters of submits are an abbreviation; written out in full it names the obesity measure

explanation.surface: Someone who has put on weight yields to having their obesity measured.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of 'submits' is BMI; 'Having expanded' tells you to spell that abbreviation out in full.
explanation.definitionFit: Weight divided by height squared is the standard index doctors use to judge obesity.

clue.text: Army in line goes mad for her

indicators.note: going mad means losing order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A soldier in the ranks becomes infatuated with a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'her': a female name.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, most famously Monroe's, fits a pronoun for a woman.

clue.text: Beings worshipped high tide, one with water endlessly rising

indicators.note: high as in intoxicated, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means read from the bottom up
endlessly means drop the final letter

parts.note: the sea is a body of water

explanation.surface: Gods worshipped as the tide comes in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high' shuffles TIDE into DEIT; SEA minus its end is SE, which 'rising' turns into ES.
explanation.definitionFit: Gods and goddesses are beings that people worship.

clue.text: Imagine the setter had worried interminably

parts.note: the setter refers to himself as I, so I had becomes I'd

indicators.note: interminably means without an end, so the final letter goes

parts.note: eaten means worried, as in what's eating you

explanation.surface: The setter fancies he had been anxious without end.
explanation.definitionFit: To form an idea in the mind is to imagine or conceive it.

clue.text: Keen to get some of Stone Age relics

indicators.note: some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An archaeologist eager to acquire prehistoric artefacts.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean enthusiastic and impatient for something.

clue.text: Collective 15, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a collection of people or things gathered together
refers to the answer at 15 down, an example of a band

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a collection of people and a band of musicians, such as the one at 15.

clue.text: Attempted once again to save thousands, and cut anew

indicators.note: to save means to hold and keep, so the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: retried means tried again
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so two of them make thousands

explanation.surface: Someone trying again to save thousands by making cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair or a hedge trimmed a second time has been cut once more.

clue.text: Hussy's beginning to entice author

parts.note: trollop is an old-fashioned word for a hussy

indicators.note: beginning to asks for the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A shameless woman starting to lure a writer.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony Trollope was a Victorian novelist, author of the Barsetshire novels.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony and Joanna, both English novelists, share this surname.

clue.text: Driven model organised festival — not large? Not very

indicators.note: organised means arranged anew, so the remaining letters are rearranged
Not again tells us to leave out the letter for very
not tells us to leave out the letter for large

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: A modest festival was organised: not big, not very big at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Festival' wants to be the definition, but it is the fodder: FESTIVAL loses L and V, and 'organised' turns the remaining FESTIA around.
explanation.definitionFit: The Fiesta is a Ford car model, something people drive.

clue.text: Spent former writer died before his boss?

indicators.note: before places the letter for died ahead of the boss

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
a pen is a writing instrument
d is the abbreviation for died, as in family trees
a writer's boss is the editor, abbreviated ED

explanation.surface: A one-time writer, exhausted, died before his superior did.
explanation.definitionFit: Money used up or energy exhausted has been spent.

clue.text: Additional comment by unknown revolutionary soul

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a comment added to a letter
Y is an algebraic unknown
Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: A postscript about a mysterious radical's spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: From the Greek word for breath, it means the human spirit or mind.
